log.summary: Parsed: total {{total}}s / {{stints}} stints / {{actions}} actions / {{cooldowns}} Skill/Burst cooldowns / {{effects}} effects ({{cooldownKeys}} trigger intervals, {{internal}} excluded as internal) / seed {{seed}}
log.sacrificialOk: Using random seed {{seed}}, where gcsim also triggers at all {{expected}} app triggers with no extra triggers ({{searched}} seeds searched)
log.sacrificialNg: No seed matched the app's triggers ({{searched}} seeds searched), so the closest seed {{seed}} is used (of {{expected}} app triggers: {{matched}} also triggered in gcsim, {{missing}} triggered in the app but not in gcsim, {{extras}} triggered in gcsim but not in the app). Skill cooldown lengths may differ from what the app shows
log.waits: Cooldown waits (gcsim could not act and waited): {{count}}
log.stintsTitle: Stints and actions (start time / length until the next; length = action time + delay)
log.effectsTitle: Effects (triggered buffs and states; keys marked as "effect" in the dictionary)

er.title: Energy Recharge Calculator
er.intro: Runs the current rotation for {{laps}} laps in gcsim and finds the total Energy Recharge (ER%) needed for every character's burst. It collects the requirement for each span between bursts (a window) and shows it in three levels.
er.stale: The party or rotation has changed since this calculation. Please recalculate.
er.oldVersion: This result was computed with gcsim {{saved}} (now {{current}}). Please recalculate.
er.errorMismatch: Even with very high ER, burst timing does not match the baseline (run ignoring energy). Bursts are shifted for a reason other than energy.
er.note: Required ER is the total, including weapon and artifact substats. Particles are random, so three levels are shown (windows: {{seeds}} seeds × {{laps}} laps). Characters start with full energy, so the first-lap bursts always succeed. The normal calculation (applying results to the chart) is not affected.
er.phaseVerify: Verifying the Certain values in gcsim
er.colTypicalTitle: Enough in half of the windows (median). A rough guide for real play
er.colStableTitle: Enough in 90% of the windows. Occasionally a lap falls short
er.colCertainTitle: Enough in every collected window (verified in gcsim). Works even with the worst luck, so it reads high because it picks the worst random window
